characters.binding_constraint: Bind the visual pieces (person, tree) with the sound 'xiū' and the 1st flat tone into a scene that means 'to rest'.
Bind the visual pieces (woman, child) with the sound 'hǎo' and the 3rd dipping tone into a scene that means 'good'.
Bind the visual pieces (one long eyebrow, two eyelids) with the sound 'lì' and the 4th falling tone into a scene that means 'beautiful'.
